review:
Majestic Express – Gold Run is a mining slot with money symbols worth up to 15x on reels 1 to 4, collected when a Collect or Super Collect symbol lands on reel five. Train Money symbols can carry much bigger prizes, up to 5,000x.

If a Super Collect lands together with a Train Money symbol, a golden train appears with a random number of carts, each adding +1x to the win multiplier. Three dynamite scatters lead to the bonus. The in-game screens advertise up to 20,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. A fun twist on reel-five collector games.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
